body.title: ci: publish and read a report for each judge branch
body.body:
Only .github/workflows/ci.yml changes.

- A push to a `judge/**` branch now runs CI, and its publish job writes the report to `reports/<branch with / as ->.json` on the `ci-reports` branch (for example `reports/judge-U01.json`). A push to `main` still writes `main.json`, as before.
- The pull request job reads the report of its base branch (the same path) for the base coverage total; for a pull request into `main` this is `main.json`, as before.
- The gate needs the publish job on judge branches too.

The test steps, the pinned step, the report job, the marker artifact and the secrets job do not change. The judge branches give each demo case one merged change and its own report, for a judge site.

body.title: ci: add the protected regression step and the report hash marker
body.body:
## What

This brings the demo repository to the same tree as the bank repository at 356cb19.

- **Protected regression step:** `scripts/pinned.py`, called from `scripts/repro.py`. Base copies of the changed tests run on the head code, so a change cannot pass by editing an old test.
- **Report hash marker:** the `report` job and the `publish-main-report` job upload the CI report as an artifact whose name carries the report hash and the run attempt. Both steps are in jobs that run no repository code.
- The tests for both, and the earlier path checks of the repro script.

## Tests

The CI commands pass on this tree: `ruff check`, `ruff format --check`, `pytest` (359 passed).

## Effect on the open case pull requests

A case pull request gets the new report blocks only after it is closed and reopened on the new base.
